input.quote: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
input.rationale: Article XIII is entirely one-sided: only Licensor benefits from the consequential-damages exclusion, and only Licensor's aggregate liability is capped — at one half of amounts paid, which is far below the walk-away floor of six months' fees, while our client's liability (including the broad Article XII indemnity) remains unlimited. There are no carve-outs for confidentiality, data/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement. The redline makes both the exclusion and the cap mutual, sets the cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, adds uncapped Excluded Claims, and confirms Licensee's fee obligations are not damages for cap purposes.

proposal.summary: Make Article XIII exclusion and cap mutual, reset cap to greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000, and add uncapped Excluded Claims
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the damages exclusion and the liability cap mutual and reset the cap to the greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000; as drafted only Licensor was capped (at one half of amounts paid) while Licensee's exposure was unlimited. Indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Licensee's fee obligations are not counted against it; a mutual cap of 12 months' fees with at least those carve-outs is our fallback.

ops.oldText: (a) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE TO LICENSEE OR TO ANY THIRD PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES
ops.newText: (a) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES

ops.oldText: (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED ONE HALF OF THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE LICENSEE TO Licensor HEREUNDER.
ops.newText: (b) EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (i) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY LICENSEE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (ii) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES AND SHALL NOT COUNT AGAINST THIS LIMITATION.
